div.div:
Solid = learning MVP (one Spot node, one replica, in-cluster PostgreSQL, HTTP via ALB DNS, same-day teardown).
Dashed = deferred per ADR 0002: RDS / S3 / Secrets Manager return in P7 sessions; Route 53 + ACM stay documented in the production profile
(private multi-AZ nodes, multiple replicas, Multi-AZ RDS, autoscaling, WAF).
